explainer.description:
The explainer type associated with this interpreter, which is set to 'SimpleResidual'. This field indicates that the
interpreter will focus on explaining the residuals in a simple manner. It allows easy interpretation of the model errors
using residuals, providing clarity in understanding model performance.

initKwargs.description:
If the {@link #explainer} is a native Python class, these kwargs will be used to initialize the explainer in
addition to a native model or its process function.

callKwargs.description:
Keyword arguments for an {@link #explainer}'s interpret function. If the {@link #explainer} is a function, then
the native model being interpreted, or its process function, will also be passed in.

actionRequirement.description:
The {@link Action.Requirement minimal action requirement} in which all MlInterpreter methods for the pipe will be executed,
except {@link #interpret}, which may be overwritten by the pipe's action requirement, if set @see MlCustomPipe.actionRequirement.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title:
This type represents a generalized interpreter used in the C3 AI platform for explaining residuals in machine learning models.
It builds upon the concept of simple residual interpretation but provides flexibility for a wider range of use cases.

Residuals refer to the differences between the predicted values of a model and the actual observed values. A residual interpreter
like this one helps in understanding why a model may be underperforming, providing insights that guide model improvement.

The `GeneralSimpleResidualInterpreter` extends the `SimpleResidualInterpreter` but is designed to work in a broader context,
making it applicable to a wider range of data scenarios. Like the basic `SimpleResidualInterpreter`, it focuses on providing
straightforward explanations for the model's residuals but may be customized further for more advanced use cases.

This entity is useful in cases where a deeper or more generalized understanding of the residuals across different models and
data sets is required, offering flexibility in machine learning model explanation.
name: ReliabilityRiskMl.Pipeline.Interpreter.GeneralSimpleResidualInterpreter
